tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground. Neutral, deliberately not blue: a blue-grey canvas plus a blue accent reads as a template before a reader has parsed a number.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, plates, tables, popovers — anything that sits one step above the ground.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed ground: control tracks, table row hover, quiet plates. Always sits between canvas and surface in both themes, so a recess is a recess everywhere.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating chrome only (sticky navigation capsules). Never behind text that must be read through it.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: Values, headings, the answer. Contrast ≥ 15:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body, labels, control labels on tinted ground. Contrast ≥ 8:1.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Micro labels, units, table headers, meta. Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 — the floor.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Icons, rules and dashed chart guides only. Never text: it does not meet 4.5:1 and is exempt on that condition alone.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interaction, selection, focus and magnitude bars. Ink that happens to be blue (chroma ≈ 0.09), not a link blue.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and active states of an accent element; the label of the active navigation tab.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected-row ground, active tab ground, accent tint. Never a fill for a large plate.

tokens.name: accent-plate
tokens.usage: The one filled control per view (primary button). It is ink, not the accent hue — a filled accent button competes with the hero figure.

tokens.name: accent-plate-ink
tokens.usage: Label on accent-plate. Nothing else carries white text except the chart label chips.

tokens.name: pos
tokens.usage: Signed gain only — a number that carries a plus sign. Never a magnitude, never decoration, never "success" chrome.

tokens.name: neg
tokens.usage: Signed loss only. Deep and desaturated so forty rows of money do not shout at each other.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caveat copy and the sell marker in the price chart. Never an error fill.

tokens.name: pos-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for a signed positive state. The only place a signed colour may be a fill.

tokens.name: neg-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for a signed negative state.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: The one hairline: card borders, table rules, dividers. Structure before surface — a card edge must read from this line alone.

tokens.name: hair-strong
tokens.usage: Measure tracks (ranked bars, progress), control borders, segmented track inset.

tokens.name: chart-label-bg
tokens.usage: Price chip drawn on the chart line. Carries white text; the only mark besides accent-plate that does.

tokens.name: chart-cost-label-bg
tokens.usage: Average-cost chip on the chart. Deliberately quieter than the price chip — a past level is context, not the answer.

families.sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

styles.name: type-hero
styles.usage: The one number the page exists for. Fluid in the app: clamp(32px, 2.4vw + 16px, 40px) — 32px below the 680px breakpoint, 40px from 1000px up.

styles.name: type-hero-sm
styles.usage: Mobile hero. Not a desktop tier — it owns its own leading so a 32px number is never set on a 44px line.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Page title, secondary money figure, the percent inside a large mosaic tile.

styles.name: type-fig
styles.usage: Panel headings and the figure a plate is built around.

styles.name: type-row
styles.usage: Values that carry the answer inside a row, and metric-band values.

styles.name: type-body
styles.usage: Names, prose, control labels. 400 for prose, 500 for controls.

styles.name: type-micro
styles.usage: Labels, units, table headers, chart axes, legal text. The floor: nothing on the page is smaller than this, ever.

spacing.note: Base 4px. s-* is horizontal and between elements, g-* is the vertical rhythm between blocks in a column.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label, chip padding unit.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Inside a control, tight stacks.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Default control padding, label-to-value.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: Card interior in dense contexts, table cell padding.

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: Standard card padding (--card-pad).

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: Section padding, plate interior.

tokens.name: s-7
tokens.usage: Between bands, hero plate padding.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: Page margin at desktop; the widest deliberate gap.

tokens.name: g-1
tokens.usage: Label to its value inside a stack.

tokens.name: g-2
tokens.usage: Tight block rhythm inside a card.

tokens.name: g-3
tokens.usage: Standard block gap in a column.

tokens.name: g-4
tokens.usage: Between related cards.

tokens.name: g-5
tokens.usage: Between panels of one section.

tokens.name: g-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: g-7
tokens.usage: Between the page's major bands.

radius.note: Shape follows size, not fashion. The radius is a function of what the element is.

tokens.name: r-1
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, ticks, the segmented thumb.

tokens.name: r-2
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, tabs, the segmented track. A control is never a pill.

tokens.name: r-3
tokens.usage: Cards and navigation capsules.

tokens.name: r-4
tokens.usage: Hero plates, the chart plate, modals.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Single-line badges, dots, avatars and the sliding segmented thumb only — where matching the end cap is the point.

shadow.note: Three levels. Never a shadow without a line: every shadowed surface also carries a 1px hair border.

tokens.name: sh-plate
tokens.usage: Elevation 1: cards, tables, the chart plate.

tokens.name: sh-float
tokens.usage: Elevation 2: sticky navigation capsules floating over content.

tokens.name: sh-overlay
tokens.usage: Elevation 3: dialogs, popovers, command palettes — always with a scrim.

size.note: Font sizes as values, so components can reference var(--fs-*) instead of hard-coding a px. The Typography styles above carry the same numbers with leading and tracking.

tokens.name: fs-micro
tokens.usage: Floor — labels, units, axes, legal.

tokens.name: fs-body
tokens.usage: Names, prose, control labels.

tokens.name: fs-row
tokens.usage: Row values, metric-band values.

tokens.name: fs-fig
tokens.usage: Panel figures.

tokens.name: fs-title
tokens.usage: Titles, secondary money.

tokens.name: fs-hero-sm
tokens.usage: Mobile hero.

tokens.name: fs-hero
tokens.usage: The hero figure. The only fluid size in the system; its endpoints are tier values.

tokens.name: lh-micro
tokens.usage: Micro labels.

tokens.name: lh-body
tokens.usage: Body and prose.

tokens.name: lh-row
tokens.usage: Row values.

tokens.name: lh-fig
tokens.usage: Panel figures.

tokens.name: lh-title
tokens.usage: Titles.

tokens.name: lh-hero-sm
tokens.usage: Mobile hero.

tokens.name: lh-hero
tokens.usage: Hero figure; ramps with its size so the ratio stays ~1.1.

tracking.note: All figures use tabular-nums with ZERO tracking. Tracked digits cannot be compared down a column.

tokens.name: tr-tight
tokens.usage: Display and title tiers.

tokens.name: tr-snug
tokens.usage: Row and figure tiers.

tokens.name: tr-normal
tokens.usage: Body, prose, all numbers.

tokens.name: tr-wide
tokens.usage: Micro labels only.

weight.note: The only weights in the system. Fractional weights such as 550 or 620 render unpredictably on non-variable fallback fonts.

tokens.name: fw-regular
tokens.usage: Prose, long labels.

tokens.name: fw-medium
tokens.usage: Controls, table headers, micro labels.

tokens.name: fw-semibold
tokens.usage: Titles, figures, values that carry the answer.

tokens.name: fw-display
tokens.usage: The hero number only.

control.note: Density contract: a card is padded 20, a table row is 48, a control is 28 / 34 / 40 tall.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Dense toolbars, table row controls.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Default control height: buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions and the search field.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Data-table row height, in both densities.
